claims.text: Tác phẩm có thật, tên: Lesser Diacosmos

sources.quote: The physical works are these: III. The Great Diacosmos (which the school of Theophrastus attribute to Leucippus). The Lesser Diacosmos.
the Great World System and the Little World System
as he says himself in the Lesser Diacosmos, a young man when Anaxagoras was old

notes: DL IX.41: Democritus tự nói trong Lesser Diacosmos rằng sách soạn 730 năm sau khi thành Troy thất thủ.
